notice: Policy-gap register seed from the user-supplied framework. A gap records real revenue exposure with no legal route; it is evidence for law-reform discussion, never a finding against a taxpayer.

gaps.title: No codified arm's-length standard
gaps.description: The framework reports that the High Court (AfriSam) held section 113 does not let RSL impute notional amounts, such as interest on an interest-free related-party loan, by applying an arm's-length standard the section does not contain, and identified the absence of a codified standard as a gap in Lesotho's law.
